neighbours.label: the piece ' Mat' / ' mat' starting a longer word or name (matinee, Matlock)
fire: The biographer Ruth Matlock wrote about her childhood in Ohio.
Her sister Matilda was married in a small chapel.
The head matron inspected every ward in the hospital.
His friend Matias drove them to the airport.
All freshmen must matriculate before the end of August.
We went to a Tuesday matinee with my aunt.
The deli on the corner sells Matzo ball soup.
Professor Alan Matlock reviewed the manuscript.
quiet: The biographer Ruth Mitchell wrote about her childhood in Ohio.
Her sister Natalie was married in a small chapel.
The head nurse inspected every ward in the hospital.
His friend Martin drove them to the airport.
All freshmen must register before the end of August.
We went to a Tuesday concert with my aunt.
The deli on the corner sells mature cheddar cheese.
Professor Alan Mason reviewed the manuscript.

notes: Whole-word tokens such as ' mattress' and ' material' stay quiet in probes, and the word 'mat' itself is weak. Tokenizer splits were checked before registering.
